title: BetterChestShops
description: A fun, Refreshing ChestShop plugin without all the extras!
body:
BetterChestShops is a simple, lightweight chest shop plugin for 1.21.1+ servers. It ditches the bloated GUIs, messy sign syntax, and complex dependencies. Instead, it uses physical "Rule Items" to handle trades.

What it does:
You hold an item, type a command to turn it into an "Input" or "Output" rule button, and drop those buttons into a chest. That chest is now a protected shop. Because it uses physical items, it natively supports complex NBT data, custom models, and enchants without any extra configuration. It features built-in protection against hoppers and explosions, supports bulk trading via shift-click, and works flawlessly for Bedrock cross-play out of the box.

**Need any support? Join the DoccDev [discord](https://discord.gg/DfWRnvmSkb)**
**Get Beta versions at the [Github Release](https://github.com/doccyt/BetterChestShops)**
**Find More of my work at the [Website!](https://doccdev.xyz/)**

Commands
/cs create input - Creates an input rule button for the exact item and amount you are holding in your main hand.

/cs create output - Creates an output rule button for the exact item and amount you are holding in your main hand.

/cs reload - Reloads the config.yml file (Requires admin permission).

(Note: You can also use /chestshop instead of /cs)
